Monitoring: Monitor cassava field regularly (every week) after sprouting for symptoms of the disease such as dieback, angular brown or black blight lesions especially at the beginning of the wet season
Examine leaves for water soaked lesions and gummy exudates
Implement control when symptoms are seen at any stage of growth
